description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for crash report sending UI in a macOS application, including a custom NSTextField subclass and a Reporter class managing crash report dialog interactions.

classes.name: LengthLimitingTextField
classes.description: A subclass of NSTextField that enforces a maximum length on user input.

classes.name: Reporter
classes.description: A class managing the crash report dialog UI, user input, and actions such as sending or canceling the report.

methods.name: setMaximumLength:
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed length for the text field input.

methods.name: sendReport:
methods.description: Action triggered to send the crash report.

methods.name: cancel:
methods.description: Action triggered to cancel the crash report dialog.

methods.name: showPrivacyPolicy:
methods.description: Opens the privacy policy URL in the default web browser.

methods.name: control:textView:doCommandBySelector:
methods.description: Delegate method to handle command events in the text view, such as capturing Return key presses.

methods.name: commentsValue
methods.description: Getter for the comments input by the user.

methods.name: setCommentsValue:
methods.description: Setter for the comments input by the user.

methods.name: emailValue
methods.description: Getter for the email input by the user.

methods.name: setEmailValue:
methods.description: Setter for the email input by the user.

methods.name: countdownMessage
methods.description: Getter for the countdown message displayed in the dialog.

methods.name: setCountdownMessage:
methods.description: Setter for the countdown message displayed in the dialog.
